notes.title: Finding Ice Relaunch 2023
notes.notes:
As the team at DanstaStudios, we are excited to announce that our recently released game, Finding Ice, will be receiving a major update in 2023! 

This update will be available to all players on Steam and will bring with it a host of new features and improvements. Firstly, we are thrilled to reveal that Finding Ice will be receiving a complete visual overhaul. The game will now feature stunning new graphics, with improved lighting and detail. The colour schemes have also been updated, bringing a fresh new look to the game. 

In addition to the visual updates, we have also completely overhauled the story of Finding Ice. The game will now follow the emotional journey of an Inuit attempting to build a better future for his family in the face of climate change and biodiversity loss. This heart-wrenching narrative will have players fully immersed in the game's world, and is sure to leave a lasting impact. 

But wait, that's not all! We have also added new and updated gameplay mechanics to make the gameplay even more interesting and engaging. The game is now more optimised, with improved performance and a smoother experience overall. 

At DanstaStudios, we believe that it is important to give back to the community and make a positive impact on the world. That's why we are proud to announce that a portion of the revenues from Finding Ice will be donated to charities such as WWF and Animals Asia. These organizations work tirelessly to protect the environment and the animals that call it home, and we are grateful to be able to support their important global work.

We hope that through our commitment to donating a portion of our profits, we can inspire others to make a difference and contribute to creating a better world for all. Thank you for supporting Finding Ice and for helping us to make a positive impact on the world.

All of these updates come together to create an even more emotional and immersive experience for players. We can't wait for you to get your hands on the updated version of Finding Ice and experience everything it has to offer. Keep an eye out for the update on Steam in 2023 and get ready for an emotional journey unlike any other.

notes.title: Animals and Pets Arrive!
notes.notes:
We're excited to announce that animals and 'pets' have now been added to Finding Ice - something that will help enhance gameplay.

[b][h2]Pets Have Arrived![/h2][/b]

You can now explore the East falls in the company of a 'pet' which changes with each map you unlock. Why not discover the Central Waterfall with an eagle flying high above you or a rabbit hopping alongside you? With each level, you will have the opportunity to play alongside a different pet animal while learning a little about their natural traits which make them essential for the survival of the natural world - find a variety of new challenges based on the arrival of your new pet animal as you no longer fight to save the memories of an Arctic Wolf but also those of your pet!

[b][h2]Animals now wander around certain areas of maps: [/h2][/b]

There is nothing better than exploring a video game map whilst being able to interact with the animals and nature that surround you. What will you find? Beavers? Deer? Rabbits? Eagles?

Prior to release, we plan on adding new and exciting features which allow you to continue playing Finding Ice regardless of whether you have completed the story or not...

[i][u][b]WISHLIST FINDING ICE TODAY![/b][/u][/i]

notes.title: Devlog 1 is Here!
notes.notes:
Hello everyone! 
We're so excited to share with you a few of the things we have been working on over the past year. Finding Ice has been in development for over 2 years now and is nearing its release to Steam this month.
[b]
[h3]A brief introduction to Finding Ice:[/h3][/b]
Finding Ice is a game that aims to inspire the player to make small changes in their lives to help the planet and limit climate change. The player explores several large maps as a third-person Arctic Wolf, interacting with the natural surroundings, uncovering clues and challenges and interacting with in-game animals. [i]If you're a fan of adventure games, walking simulators and story/puzzle games, Finding Ice is for you.[/i]
[i][b]
Before you read any further, hit that 'wishlist' button on the Steam store page to be notified when Finding Ice is released - you won't want to miss it.[/b][/i]

Will you re-connect with nature and help to restore balance to the natural world? Or will you be a bystander to one of the worst catastrophes of all time? The choice is yours in this unique video game.

[h3]A bit about DanstaStudios:[/h3]
DanstaStudios is a small indie game development studio which primarily focuses on developing video games that will make a difference in the world. Our latest video game, Finding Ice (wishlist now) follows the story of an Arctic wolf attempting to unlock the secrets of his past in the face of man-made climate change. 
[h3]
So, what features have been added since previous updates?[/h3]

Well, we've been hard at work creating beautiful awe-inspiring worlds and adding a sprinkle of life into each map through the implementation of animals. We've added lakes, rivers and mountainous waterfalls coupled with outstanding swimming mechanics. So, what are you waiting for? WISHLIST TODAY AND SPREAD THE WORD!

Finding Ice will be released later this month.

Thank you - please stay tuned for updates on progress!
